text: Objective: This program provides in-depth knowledge and techniques in chemistry, pharmacy and pharmaceutical engineering. Student will engage in a series of research work in drug formulation, process designing and innovation, new drug research and development. Future job opportunities include: senior technicians in pharmaceutical engineering and production, management, research and design of new medicine. Degree Requirements: Students in this program spend the first 2 years studying the basic sciences, biology and chemistry courses. In the first semester of the 3rd Year of their undergraduate study, student must choose from different areas of concentration. Upon graduation, students must have completed core courses, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing.
